hook: Wind your own moon by selling Hares, then cash each Full Moon for permanent stats and borrowed powers.
loop: Sell and play Hares to turn the moon toward Full.
Full Moons pay permanent stats and switch on Borrow.
Borrowers copy neighbours' text, doubling your best cards in fights.

growth.line: Small permanent gifts to every Hare at each Full Moon; the Moon-Scour's gift grows with every Full.

feel.early: Solid bodies for turn 3's natural Full fight.
feel.mid: Winding the moon; picking shop and fight phases.
feel.late: A fork: Full every turn, or Leverets copying Hares.

stars.why: Sell him to turn the moon; he comes back every turn.
Borrows its left neighbour's text at Full Moon; slot order matters.
Every Full Moon you've wound earlier pays again, bigger each time.

card_short.u01: Moonlit: Bristle. Grows permanently at each Full Moon.
card_short.u02: Sell it to turn the moon.
card_short.u03: Borrows the text of the unit to its left.
card_short.u04: Full Moon: permanent stats to the units next to it.
card_short.u05: New Moon: gain 2 gold, once a turn.
card_short.u06: Turns the moon when it dies in a fight.
card_short.u07: New Moon: summons a Leveret in the back row.
card_short.u08: Sell him to turn the moon; returns next turn.
card_short.u09: End of Turn: permanent stats behind it; double when Waning.
card_short.u10: Moonlit, in fights: borrows the text of the enemy across.
card_short.u11: First Hare you play each turn turns the moon.
card_short.u12: Full Moon: permanent stats to all your other Hares.
card_short.u13: Its permanent gains are copied to the units beside it.
card_short.u14: Your Full Moon and New Moon triggers fire twice.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: boxes the enemy across; untouchable when Moonlit.
card_short.u16: Always borrows your biggest non-Hare unit's text.
card_short.u17: Moon skips Waning and New; Full Moon buffs all Hares.
card_short.u18: Full Moon: buffs Hares more for every Full this game.
card_short.u19: New Moon: summons a Leveret; borrowing Leverets become Hare copies.
card_short.x01: 1/1 token; borrows the text of the unit in front.

builds.name: The clock
builds.line: Turn the moon three times a shop for a Full every turn.

builds.name: Borrowed shapes
builds.line: A few Hares copying another tribe's best units' text.

builds.name: Dark of the moon
builds.line: New Moons bring gold and Leverets; Grandam turns them into copies.

liked: Winding the moon so shop and fight phases differ: a real choice every turn.
Old Wat stood out to all three; Borrow plays unlike any of today's tribes.
worries: Grandam doesn't work as written: she fires at New, Leverets borrow only at Full.
Watch: Silverpenny copying capstones, Waxwell stacking with Meikle Care, Grandam's triples.
changed: Grandam's copies now count for triples and never copy a Grandam.
Borrowed sell and death text now fires, so Leverets can turn the moon free.
Waxwell now doubles Once a turn triggers; Longshanks' bout ends after 5 hits.
verdict: Positional combo puzzlers get a moon to wind, timing each Full Moon for stats and borrowed powers.
